nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Improve hand appearance in generated model or lifestyle images.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the image requiring hand repair. The image must be between 300 and 4096 pixels in both width and height, and its width-to-height ratio must be between 0.4 and 2.5.

maskUrl.description: Optional mask URL for the hand repair area.

outputNum.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.

personType.description: Person type. Supported values: 0 (girl), 1 (boy), 2 (adult woman), 3 (adult man).

name: nexscope_ai_hand_repair
title: AI Hand Repair API
